title: Command Rejection V1
description: The one contract every producer of a refused command batch answers with (ticket 26/09/30/NON-DESTRUCTIVE-HISTORY-EDITING, follow-up 3): the hub's `ApplyOutcome::Rejected`, decoded once by the actor that receives it, and every local refusal an actor answers before any frame leaves it. `code` classifies the refusal, `reason` is the producer's English diagnostic (never shown to a human), `messages` are the structured diagnostics the hub graded the batch with (always empty for a local refusal) and `detail` carries a local refusal's typed counters. Rust owner `🏪️store/🔄️sync/🦀️.rs` `CommandAckOutcome`, TypeScript twin `💻️os/🟦️.ts` region `🚫️CommandRejection`.

Code.title: Command Rejection Code
Code.description: `hub.refused`: the hub refused the batch and its messages decoded; `hub.unreadable`: the hub refused it and its messages did not decode; `local.read-only`: the verified execution target admits no edit; `local.queue-full`: the pending mutation queue is full; `local.backbone-capacity`: the document backbone's pending retention is full or the message breaks its hot limit; `local.backbone-duplicate`: a mutation of the batch is already retained, unsent; `local.backbone-pair-unavailable`: the document has no verified canonical pair to admit mutations against; `local.backbone-scope-mismatch`: an envelope names another document than the actor's; `local.backbone-malformed`: the backbone message does not decode; `local.socket-frame-ceiling`: one envelope's frame alone exceeds the socket's ceiling.

bytes.description: The bytes the refused message or the pending queue holds.

limit.description: The limit the refusal met, in the unit of `bytes` or of the queue.
